title: Domains of holomorphy for expanding-map components
exact_target: Ask whether the principal component, and all components of hyperbolic rational maps or polynomials, are domains of holomorphy.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300017 (AMR-052-0017). CC BY 4.0.
Curt McMullen, Rational maps and Teichmüller space, in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (editors), Problems in holomorphic dynamics (1992). Remarks, intrinsic Question, pp. 9–10.
